name: @nifrajs/workbench
description: Lightweight local Workbench client for nifra-agent.

scripts.dev: bun run build:browser && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.build:browser: bun build src/browser.ts --target browser --format esm --outfile dist/public/app.js && bun run scripts/build-assets.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:browser && bun run build:server
